pages.title: Manual Work
pages.text: Item transfer is available on manual workstations, but loading cannot generate loom passes, mortar grinding, quern cranking, mold presses, or pottery-wheel work. Ignition remains explicit rather than a side effect of fuel loading.

pages.title: Workshop Roles
pages.text: Workshop slots are input, catalyst, fuel, and output. Same-recipe top-ups preserve heated progress; fuel top-ups do not restart a paid batch. Begun forging batches lock extra material insertion and cannot be split to duplicate work.

pages.title: Barrel Faces
pages.text: Top accepts input, bottom extracts output, sides support both. Sealing locks item/fluid transfer. Input/output fluid remain separate while sharing capacity. Rising redstone edges toggle the lid.

pages.title: Recovery
pages.text: Collect waiting output and check ingredient count, catalyst, correct action, heat, ignition, and air. Sneak controls retrieve unfinished material. Packs can automate transfer without replacing the manual processing contract.
